normal.name: Nai 🌸🦉
normal.text: Oh yeah it’s pretty expensive at full price 😭 I’m loving it so far; I can’t give a real verdict yet since I’m still early in game, but I think it’s worth it! Maybe wait for a sale if you’re unsure, but if you like cozy farming sims and can handle some small jumpscares, I’d say it’s a good find ♥️
